frequency_question: What proportion of major partisan bills meeting preliminary success conditions actually satisfy all precise statutory wording and successor-clause criteria without failing technical definitions?
membership_rule: Members are major partisan bills that clear initial chambers or reach Senate consideration; excluded are non-legislative resolutions and broad policy declarations without specific statutory text.
provenance_note: 5 cases named, 6 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.2x)
coverage_note: 5 named; believed roughly 6 in total for this specific high-scrutiny category
known_gaps: Excludes minor amendments and appropriations riders not tracked as standalone major acts.
skeleton: Major enacted partisan/bipartisan legislative vehicles satisfying specific text requirements divided by total major bills reaching final Senate passage stages.
multiplier: 5 hits out of 6 major attempted vehicles meeting substantive threshold = 83 percent
validity_reason: Senate procedural rules and legislative drafting conventions remain stable across these congressional terms.
